healthy. kitchenHigh Protein Chicken Burrito Bowls v

Meal prep for the week! Serves 4

INGREDIENTS

e 2 lbs chicken breast

e 1 cup cooked rice

¢ 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained

¢ 1/2 cup salsa

e 1 tbsp taco seasoning

e Shredded cheese, to serve

METHOD

1. Season the chicken with the taco seasoning and

cook in a skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes

per side until golden.

2. Slice the chicken and divide the rice and beans

between four containers.

3. Top with salsa and cheese. Store in the fridge

for up to 4 days.

#mealprep #highprotein #easyrecipes
